summary: Cheetah Mobile furnished a 6-K reporting Q2 2026 results and two corporate updates. On September 11, 2026 it signed a share repurchase agreement to dispose of its entire 36.0% equity interest in a gaming-related company for about US$41.3 million cash, closing expected September 2026 subject to customary conditions. Separately, in August 2026 it bought the remaining 1% GP and 49.5% LP interests in Orion Partnership for roughly RMB90.8 million, lifting Beijing OrionStar ownership from about 73.95% to 75.83%. Watch closing conditions and any gain/loss disclosure.
